description: This file defines the interface 'FeaturePropertiesBuilder' which provides a fluent API for building and modifying instances of 'FeatureProperties', a JSON object that represents properties of a feature within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The interface includes methods for setting various types of properties (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) conditioned on predicates, as well as methods for removing, setting multiple fields, and building the final object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets an integer property if the predicate evaluates to true, or unconditionally with the default predicate.
signatures: FeaturePropertiesBuilder set(CharSequence key, int value, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a long property if the predicate evaluates to true, or unconditionally with the default predicate.
signatures: FeaturePropertiesBuilder set(CharSequence key, long value, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a double property if the predicate evaluates to true, or unconditionally with the default predicate.
signatures: FeaturePropertiesBuilder set(CharSequence key, double value, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a boolean property if the predicate evaluates to true, or unconditionally with the default predicate.
signatures: FeaturePropertiesBuilder set(CharSequence key, boolean value, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a String property if the predicate evaluates to true, or unconditionally with the default predicate.
signatures: FeaturePropertiesBuilder set(CharSequence key, @Nullable String value, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonValue property if the predicate evaluates to true, or unconditionally with the default predicate.
signatures: FeaturePropertiesBuilder set(CharSequence key, JsonValue value, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property defined by a JsonFieldDefinition if the predicate evaluates to true.
signatures: <T> FeaturePropertiesBuilder set(JsonFieldDefinition<T> fieldDefinition, @Nullable T value, Predicate<JsonField> predicate)

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a given JsonField if the predicate evaluates to true.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a property associated with the given key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a property associated with the given JSON field definition.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields, avoiding duplicates, with all fields satisfying the predicate.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields, avoiding duplicates, with all fields.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all fields from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an instance of FeatureProperties containing all set values.
